slides.transcript:
Problem

Most cabs in 2008 use aging & inefficient technology.

Taxi-monopolies reduce the quality of service.

No GPS coordination between client/driver.

Uber
slides.summary: The 2008 taxi industry suffers from technological obsolescence and monopolistic structures that degrade service quality. A critical friction point is the lack of GPS-enabled coordination between service providers and customers.
key_points: Most cabs in 2008 use aging & inefficient technology
Taxi-monopolies reduce the quality of service
No GPS coordination between client/driver

Solution

Automate dispatch to reduce wait-time.

Optimized fleets and incentivized drivers.
